description: Upstream license texts for Ghostty Zig packages whose fetched tree has no license file. scripts/collect-ghostty-licenses.py ships these files from the repository, checks each SHA-256, and never downloads them. Each upstream URL is immutable (a commit, a content-addressed archive, or an archived snapshot). To change a file: copy it byte for byte from its upstream, update its sha256 here, update PINNED_MANIFEST_SHA256 in the collector, and record the review in NOTICES-REVIEW-LEDGER.md. "vendored" reviews every Ghostty pkg/<name> and vendor/<name> directory that has no license file of its own (ghostty_vendored.py): Reviewed in Ghostty trees aea262f8, 324c0273, b1a49b60 (manaflow-ai/ghostty) and 68ac618d, bbb7320b (manaflow-ai/ghostty-next). Each file is listed with the sha256 values reviewed.

dear-bindings.note: dearimgui/dear_bindings tag DearBindings_v0.17_ImGui_v1.92.5-docking (commit 2b12a291), the archive pkg/dcimgui fetches.

iterm2-themes.note: mbadolato/iTerm2-Color-Schemes release-20260713-155359-c3968b3 (commit c3968b38), the archive Ghostty's iterm2_themes dependency fetches: https://deps.files.ghostty.org/ghostty-themes-release-20260713-155359-c3968b3.tgz is byte-equal to that release's ghostty-themes.tgz (sha256 14b3044bef67a3cb83523973bd16d3aa0fb0096ddd1e0ecba3916d14d6d67f20). The archive holds the theme files only. The LICENSE is byte-equal at fc73ce39 (release-20260216-151611-fc73ce3, the snapshot in cmux's Resources/ghostty/themes).

unicode-16.note: Unicode License v3 as https://www.unicode.org/license.txt published it on 2024-09-25, two weeks after Unicode 16.0.0 (2024-09-10). The live URL changes its copyright year; this archived snapshot does not.

z2d.note: vancluever/z2d tag v0.11.0 (commit 5184a796). Both files are byte-equal to the release archive https://deps.files.ghostty.org/z2d-0.11.0-j5P_HtLzDwBGyQt49DrT0v4BuVqI_SRs6CXsuj7eBVhR.tar.gz (sha256 d48b117307f767ca379bf31bd171880e66dcafb89eca4a8f923222619992fcb4); the package's build.zig.zon .paths drops them from the fetched tree.

zig-gobject.note: ghostty-org/zig-gobject release 0.8.0-2026-04-23-26-1 (commit 6971b412), the generated GTK bindings Ghostty's gobject dependency fetches: https://deps.files.ghostty.org/gobject-2026-04-23-26-1.tar.zst is byte-equal to that release's ghostty-gobject-0.8.0-2026-04-23-26-1.tar.zst (sha256 642e324b3644c00464a2161e4af497f73cbbe8ce02a4c0edb92aacb365748047); its build.zig.zon .paths drops the LICENSE.

simdutf.note: simdutf/simdutf tag v9.0.0 (commit ca7acbce), the version of Ghostty's vendored amalgamation pkg/simdutf/vendor/ (SIMDUTF_VERSION 9.0.0). simdutf is Apache-2.0 OR MIT; both texts ship. isadetection-NOTICE.txt is lines 1-44 of include/simdutf/internal/isadetection.h at that commit (the PyTorch BSD-3-Clause notice for the CPU feature detection code), byte-equal to the copy inside the vendored simdutf.h.

lss.note: Linux Syscall Support (Google LLC, BSD-3-Clause), vendored by Ghostty as pkg/breakpad/vendor/third_party/lss/linux_syscall_support.h. The text is lines 1-31 of that header (its license comment); the URL is the Ghostty fork commit b1a49b60 that the reviewed trees share (same blob c80fbfd7 in every reviewed tree). Breakpad and LSS build only for Linux targets; the notice ships anyway (remove-doubt rule).

glad.note: Dav1dde/glad tag v2.0.8 (commit 73db193f), the generator of Ghostty's vendor/glad (gl.h: 'Loader generated by glad 2.0.8', SPDX (WTFPL OR CC0-1.0) AND Apache-2.0). The LICENSE covers the generator (MIT), the Khronos specifications (Apache-2.0 notice) and the EGL headers (Khronos MIT-style text, as in khrplatform.h); the full Apache-2.0 text ships with simdutf. khrplatform-NOTICE.txt is lines 4-25 of vendor/glad/include/KHR/khrplatform.h (the Khronos license comment) at Ghostty fork commit b1a49b60 (same blob 01646449 in every reviewed tree).

fira-code.note: tonsky/FiraCode tag 6.2 (commit eee6db99); Ghostty's pkg/freetype/res/FiraCode-Regular.ttf is Version 6.002 (name table) under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Used by Ghostty's freetype tests; the notice ships anyway (remove-doubt rule).

pkg/android-ndk.note: Ghostty's Zig wrapper that adds Android NDK paths; no third-party files.

pkg/apple-sdk.note: Ghostty's Zig wrapper and its own include/math.h shim.

pkg/breakpad.note: Ghostty's Zig build of breakpad (fetched package, its license is collected) plus the vendored LSS header; LSS ships its BSD-3-Clause text.

pkg/dcimgui.note: Ghostty's Zig wrapper and its own ext.cpp; Dear Bindings and Dear ImGui are fetched packages (dear-bindings is pinned in packages).

pkg/fontconfig.note: Override headers derived from fontconfig (Keith Packard and others, fontconfig license); the fetched fontconfig package's COPYING is collected.

pkg/freetype.note: Ghostty's Zig wrapper, its own freetype-zig.h, and the FiraCode test font (OFL-1.1, pinned).

pkg/glslang.note: override/glslang/build_info.h is Khronos BSD-3-Clause from glslang; the fetched glslang package's license is collected. test/simple.frag is Ghostty's test shader.

pkg/gtk4-layer-shell.note: Ghostty's Zig wrapper; no third-party files.

pkg/harfbuzz.note: Ghostty's Zig wrapper; no third-party files.

pkg/highway.note: src/cpp/*.cc are modified copies of google/highway (Apache-2.0 / BSD-3-Clause, SPDX headers kept); the fetched highway package's licenses are collected.

pkg/libintl.note: GNU gettext libintl headers and a generated config.h (LGPL-2.1-or-later); the fetched gettext package's COPYING texts are collected.

pkg/libpng.note: pnglibconf.h is libpng's generated configuration header (libpng license); the fetched libpng package's LICENSE is collected.

pkg/libxml2.note: Override config headers that recreate libxml2's generated headers; the fetched libxml2 package's Copyright is collected.

pkg/macos.note: Ghostty's Zig bindings and its own C helpers (os/zig_macos.c, text/ext.c).

pkg/oniguruma.note: Ghostty's Zig wrapper; no third-party files.

pkg/opengl.note: Ghostty's Zig bindings; no third-party files.

pkg/sentry.note: Ghostty's Zig wrapper; no third-party files.

pkg/simdutf.note: Vendored simdutf 9.0.0 amalgamation (Apache-2.0 OR MIT, with the PyTorch BSD-3-Clause notice); no fetched package carries its license.

pkg/spirv-cross.note: Ghostty's Zig wrapper; no third-party files.

pkg/translate-c.note: Ghostty's Zig translate-c helper; no third-party files.

pkg/wuffs.note: Ghostty's Zig wrapper, its own minimal libc headers and its own test images.

pkg/zlib.note: Ghostty's Zig wrapper; no third-party files.

vendor/glad.note: glad 2.0.8 generated OpenGL/EGL loader and Khronos headers, LINKED into libghostty for the OpenGL renderer on Linux and Windows; the glad LICENSE and the khrplatform.h notice ship.
